# Layer 3 reconciliation for the current target (L3-R2)

MESHSAT-1357, 30 September 2026, on the owner's instruction of that day (`v2/docs/handover/layer3/OWNER-INSTRUCTION-2026-09-30.md`, owner ruling D-21). Prototype design: no V2 board has been fabricated, ordered, assembled or powered, and no kit has been field deployed. This page reconciles the requirements handover H3 accepted (registry BASELINED at a54b793b) with the owner's decisions since and the proposals made since, and lists what closes layer 3. Its companions: `OWNER-DECISIONS-L3.md` (the owner's rows) and `REQUIREMENTS-L3-R2.md` (the consolidated specification). All three are generated from the registry and `l3r2.yaml`.

## (a) The current target configuration

**The decided target.** What the owner has approved to date (handover H3's accepted requirements, then D-19 and D-20 of 28 September and D-21, D-22, D-23 and D-24 of 30 September 2026): the V2 kit in the Peli 1450 of the current moulding (the case never changes, ruling of 7 September 2026), with the device set of V2-SPEC.md, as the owner's rulings on the rows set it:

- L3-OD7, `objective-48-72` (D-32): Row L3-OD7 of v2/docs/handover/layer3/OWNER-DECISIONS-L3.md decided by the owner's clarification D-28: M1's runtime is 48 to 72 hours, the baseline design target under the explicitly stated operating profile of REQ-072, not a mandatory minimum; no external battery; HF and the tablet functions kept, HF available and not receiving in the profile, listening an additional use; the tablet's charging optional, consuming the kit's energy and reducing endurance, which the owner accepts. Neither Option A nor Option B of the runtime comparison is adopted, and no external store is recommended (D-28).
- L3-OD1, closed as layer 4 architecture: At layer 3 the requirement is the store inside the Peli 1450, battery and solar required and no external battery (D-28; REQ-014). The store's size and arrangement is layer 4 architecture: D-06's one 4S3P pack stands as ruled, and Option A(i) (a base 4S6P and a lid pack) is carried to layer 4 as an architecture proposal (P-01), which changes D-06 and needs the owner's ruling there. It is not a layer 3 blocker.
- L3-OD2, `both-kept` (D-33): Row L3-OD2 of v2/docs/handover/layer3/OWNER-DECISIONS-L3.md decided by the owner's clarification D-28: both approved lid items stay, the QMX HF set in its lid tray (appendix 32.50 item 16a) and the tablet bracket (item 16d); no function leaves the kit. The lid pack Option A(i) would add is layer 4 architecture (row L3-OD1).
- L3-OD3, `unchanged` (D-34): Row L3-OD3 of v2/docs/handover/layer3/OWNER-DECISIONS-L3.md decided by the owner's clarification D-28: REQ-016's approved solar window stays unchanged; the 2S2P array into a 200 W stage is a layer 4 architecture proposal with Option A(i), which would need the owner's ruling to change REQ-016.
- L3-OD4, `reject` (D-35): Row L3-OD4 of v2/docs/handover/layer3/OWNER-DECISIONS-L3.md decided by the owner's clarification D-28: no deployment condition is stated at layer 3; the single benchmark plane is a modelling assumption of REQ-072's profile, not an operating restriction, and the open kit's stability goes with Option A(i)'s lid pack to layer 4.
- L3-OD5, `layer4-obligation` (D-36): Row L3-OD5 of v2/docs/handover/layer3/OWNER-DECISIONS-L3.md decided by the owner's clarification D-29: judged mode by mode against the project's maker sheets, CFL-017's collisions are between the requirements (D-02, D-02a, TEST-PLAN E5, with the pack fitted) and the current cell, the Samsung 35E, an engineering selection D-06's pack carries, with the current thermal design; the requirements are coherent. CFL-017 closes as a requirements conflict, FEA-008 carries the component-selection and thermal-design obligation to layer 4 mode by mode, and no temperature requirement is reduced, read as the kit's without its cells or reclassified.
- L3-OD6, `mean-day` (D-37): Row L3-OD6 of v2/docs/handover/layer3/OWNER-DECISIONS-L3.md decided by the owner's clarification D-28: REQ-072 is judged under SC-37's reference mean day at Leiden on one plane, 40 degrees facing south, in the typical array build (TYP), the worst array build (WAB) a sensitivity; a benchmark, not a promise under every combination of loads and weather; no coverage target.

**Facts confirmed by the check of the energy basis** ([energy-basis-check-1/CHECK-1.md](../../records/l3r2/checks/energy-basis-check-1/CHECK-1.md), of stream l3plane's ENERGY-BASIS.md, branch fnd/l3plane at 6a283b25, NOT_ACCEPTED; [energy-basis-check-2/CHECK-2.md](../../records/l3r2/checks/energy-basis-check-2/CHECK-2.md), of stream l3plane's ENERGY-BASIS.md second issue, branch fnd/l3plane at ec415c09, ACCEPTED; [energy-basis-check-3/CHECK-3.md](../../records/l3r2/checks/energy-basis-check-3/CHECK-3.md), of stream r11dep's first issue and CHECK-2's minors, branch fnd/l3plane at 4e9fa869, NOT_ACCEPTED; [energy-basis-check-4/CHECK-4.md](../../records/l3r2/checks/energy-basis-check-4/CHECK-4.md), of the energy basis's fourth issue and r11dep's second issue, branch fnd/l3plane at 06b8ecea, ACCEPTED; [energy-basis-check-5/CHECK-5.md](../../records/l3r2/checks/energy-basis-check-5/CHECK-5.md), of stream l3plane's ENERGY-BASIS.md, branch fnd/l3plane at cd8720a1ab6eed891b1afd8b5df3b8ceedf36c0f, ACCEPTED). Used now; none is a figure of the cases the check did not accept, and every M1 energy figure on these pages is the checked basis's, bound to the tip `cd8720a1ab6e` its accepted check names (`v2/docs/records/l3r2/checks/energy-basis-check-5/CHECK-5.md`); S-127 is closed (commit 9493847c).

- **CF-01, The charge bus at U3's input (VBUS20): its steady-state range and the brackets beside it.** The steady-state range, anywhere in the in-use envelope: 19.146 / 20.000 / 20.887 V (minimum, nominal, maximum), and 19.205 / 20.823 V on M1's reference day, from the makers' pages for U2's reference and the divider resistors R6 and R7. Beside it, not in it, the basis gives three brackets: 19.101 V with the divider 20 K above the inside air (an ASSUMPTION: board A has no layout; the rise warms the hot end only), 18.782 V with both resistors at their makers' 1000 h endurance limits (a test limit at far more stress than the divider sees: a bound, not an expectation), and 18.738 V with both together. The soft start (0.59 to 1.00 s after each enable) and the load and line transients are outside the steady state and move no hourly balance; the copper from R6's tap to R16 and the ground offset at U2 are layout terms not established. The basis takes the steady-state minimum, 19.146 V, as case WE, shows the endurance bracket as its own case WEL beside it and not taken, and gives the divider-rise bracket's effect as a sensitivity; an M1 claim on the basis accounts for the brackets the same way, stating them beside its result. Only the steady-state range lies inside stream s120's DC band of 19.080 to 20.960 V (v2/docs/records/s120/vbus20_bound.out); with the brackets the low end is below 19.080 V. The two checks reproduced the range (19.1458 / 20.8871 V and 19.2050 / 20.8226 V) and the second confirmed the brackets' treatment (its minors 1 to 3 of the first check answered, and its minor 8: the divider's rise gives 19.101 V, not the first check's 19.072 V). ([ENERGY-BASIS.md sections 2 and 6c, at the final tip cd8720a1](../../records/l3plane/ENERGY-BASIS.md); [vbus20_range.out](../../records/l3plane/vbus20_range.out); [the energy basis check 2, What holds](../../records/l3r2/checks/energy-basis-check-2/CHECK-2.md); [the energy basis check 5, the files verified at the tip](../../records/l3r2/checks/energy-basis-check-5/CHECK-5.md))
- **CF-02, Board A's front end in four cases: as drawn, derated, the resistor-only proposal and a hypothetical corrected power path.** (a) As drawn: board A's front-end shunt R11 is 10 mOhm and the LM5176's constant-current loop holds 4.212 / 5.000 / 5.810 A stacked, under U3's setting plus the other loads on R11 (finding A-1), and with E1's fixed setting the input bus collapses on a short source (A-2); every lid fails M1 on the reference day. (a') The derated variant, U3 at 4.00 A, makes U3 the limit (+0.052 A on 0.060 A of other loads, +0.033 A on 0.079 A) and fixes current-limit coordination only; every lid still fails M1 and carries no past window (D-25). (b) The resistor-only proposal, R11 at 6.2 mOhm and U3 at 6.2 A, is not a sufficient solution (D-24): it introduces B-1 to B-5 (L1 past its typical saturation current at the 9 V floor, the FETs at the fault current, the copper declarations passed, VBUS20's bulk capacitors over their rating at the highest permitted current, and the bus collapse again), so its energy is INCONCLUSIVE; the comparison of its limit with U3's (a margin of 0.378 A) stays closed unless its inputs change (D-25). (c) A hypothetical corrected path assumes every finding closed, A-1 and A-2, B-1 to B-5 and the missing evidence C-1 to C-9 among which Kelvin sensing at R11 within 0.29 mOhm of shared copper at 25 C is an implementation requirement, not a defect of the drawn circuit (the A32 layout reading is tied to that revision). Its energy is hypothetical, never demonstrated capability. The findings are engineering tasks with measurable criteria (power_path_corrections, closure items L3-C37 to L3-C44 and L3-C46 to L3-C53), not layer 3 prerequisites. The record's history: stream r11dep's first issue (4e9fa869) was checked once and not accepted (CHECK-3); its second issue (3ef5987e) classified the findings and was accepted (CHECK-4, of 06b8ecea); its third issue, at the final tip cd8720a1, set the derated variant at 4.00 A and was accepted (CHECK-5). ([R11-DEPENDENCY.md sections 1 and 2, at the final tip cd8720a1](../../records/r11dep/R11-DEPENDENCY.md); [r11_dep.out 3 and 6](../../records/r11dep/r11_dep.out); [three_cases.out 1 and 2](../../records/l3plane/three_cases.out); [the energy basis check 5](../../records/l3r2/checks/energy-basis-check-5/CHECK-5.md); [the energy basis check 4, What holds 2 to 5](../../records/l3r2/checks/energy-basis-check-4/CHECK-4.md))
- **CF-03, The weather record the coverage targets of row L3-OD6 are read on.** PVGIS-SARAH2 hourly irradiance on the 40 degree south plane at Leiden, September 2005 to 2020 (16 Septembers, 11520 rows), whose mean day matches the reference day's profile within 0.005 W/m2 hour by hour; every 72-hour window starting at 06 or 18 UTC on 1 to 27 September, 864 windows, a full store at each window's start. The windows' 72-hour irradiation is 3.17 kWh/m2 at the lowest, 7.36 at the 10th percentile and 11.45 at the median, against 12.0 for three reference days (SC-37's 4.0 kWh/m2 a day). The checks fetched PVGIS's September rows again and found them equal to the filed ones. The coverage each lid reaches on this record is modelled historical coverage, not a probability of success, and rests on the corrected path (case (c)). ([weather_basis.out A](../../records/l3plane/weather_basis.out); [ENERGY-BASIS.md sections 5 and 8](../../records/l3plane/ENERGY-BASIS.md); [the energy basis check 1, What holds (the weather case)](../../records/l3r2/checks/energy-basis-check-1/CHECK-1.md))
- **CF-04, Where a displaced lid item goes: no place in the kit is established.** The QMX HF set: the base has no volume for it (appendix 32.60: no bay on B16 cleared the unit, the reason it went to the lid), and outside the case it would need a lead through the back wall, which the ruled connector plate does not carry; the HF function leaves the kit unless a place is found. The tablet bracket: the tablet can be carried outside the case and used over the kit's WiFi and the USB-C outlet, but the bracket's function (a tablet held in the lid, item 16d) leaves the kit unless a place is found, and no record read establishes how the tablet travels with the kit. Nothing is designed for either. ([a1mech README section 3 item 2](../../records/a1mech/README.md); [DECISION-A1.md](../../records/a1mech/DECISION-A1.md); [ENERGY-BASIS.md section 9](../../records/l3plane/ENERGY-BASIS.md))

**Under the other answers of each row:**

- L3-OD1, option `reject`: D-06's one 4S3P pack stands as the store held; battery and solar stay mandatory, REQ-072 stays FAIL and feasibility item FI-01 records the open store problem; layer 3 cannot complete unless the owner explicitly authorises a change to M1 or to the approved functions, which D-20, D-21 and D-22 otherwise preserve.
- L3-OD2, option `qmx-out`: The QMX HF set leaves the kit and HF leaves with it, the owner's explicit decision to remove an approved function; the lid keeps an 8 inch tablet bracket beside a 4S15P lid pack.
- L3-OD2, option `qmx-outside`: The QMX HF set leaves the lid and is carried outside the case, its HF function kept through a sealed lead across the case wall; held until a record establishes that place and lead, which none does (fact CF-04); the lid keeps an 8 inch tablet bracket beside a 4S15P lid pack.
- L3-OD2, option `both-kept`: Both approved lid items stay beside a 4S9P lid pack; no function leaves the kit, the studied candidate does not meet M1 on the records (a1int RECONCILE.md; every case of the energy basis's first issue) and feasibility item FI-04 is recorded.
- L3-OD2, option `tablet-out`: The tablet bracket leaves the lid; the tablet is carried outside the case and served by the kit's WiFi and the USB-C outlet (REQ-017, deferred from prototype 1's acceptance); the QMX stays in its lid tray beside a 4S14P lid pack.
- L3-OD3, option `1s4p`: The four panels all in parallel: REQ-016 restated to at most 200 W, at most 25.6 V open circuit at -20 C cells, the array held at 16.7 to 17.6 V, an entry of 40 A and a fuse per panel; no plane grid has been run for it, so row L3-OD4 cannot adopt a band on it.
- L3-OD3, option `keep`: REQ-016's 100 W window kept, with the array and entry current the checked energy basis gives for the lid chosen (the 1600 Wp of the options sheet is for 4S18P); no plane grid has been run for it.
- L3-OD4, option `reject`: No deployment condition is stated: M1's claim stays on SC-37's reference plane (40 degrees, facing south) with no rule for the operator and no open-kit stability requirement.
- L3-OD5, option `measure`: CFL-017 stays open until the bounded enclosure heat experiment (POWER-THERMAL.md section 10) is run on hardware; layer 3 then completes with it open only by the owner's explicit authorisation.
- L3-OD5, option `cells`: Cells rated above +60 C are selected, reopening D-06's cell and spending money; CFL-017 stays open until the cell is chosen and its sheet held.
- L3-OD6, option `mean-day`: M1 stays judged on SC-37's reference mean day, with the benchmark's limitations stated in REQ-072.
- L3-OD6, option `coverage`: M1 must also meet the owner's share of the real September windows of 2005 to 2020; where the studied candidate's store does not fit the case, feasibility item FI-03 is recorded.

**Decided so far:** L3-OD2 `both-kept` by D-33 (2026-09-30); L3-OD3 `unchanged` by D-34 (2026-09-30); L3-OD4 `reject` by D-35 (2026-09-30); L3-OD5 `layer4-obligation` by D-36 (2026-09-30); L3-OD6 `mean-day` by D-37 (2026-09-30); L3-OD7 `objective-48-72` by D-32 (2026-09-30).

## (b) Every requirement-changing proposal since H3

Status APPROVED or REJECTED only on the owner's words, cited; a session proposal is AWAITING (D-21); WITHDRAWN is a session's own text it reverted; NOT_A_REQUIREMENT_CHANGE is an implementation choice or a record, listed so that nothing is missed. Changes to weather coverage, deployment restrictions, functionality, operating conditions, enclosure constraints, mission requirements, charging time or approved resources are proposals for the owner's explicit decision (D-22 to D-25): each appears only as a row or an option he answers, naming the requirement it changes with the consequence quantified (each row's owner test), never as a closure, and none is taken because the current design passes it. Component selection, sensing implementation (Kelvin sensing among it), charging below a source's available power while the approved requirements hold, and the other power-path corrections are engineering tasks, tracked downstream (D-24, D-25). No option is recommended as feasible because its idealised energy balance passes.
